verses.text: For the one directing. A Psalm of David. O YHWH, You have searched me and know [me].

segments.text: For the one directing. A Psalm of David. O YHWH, You have searched me and know [me].

verses.text: You know my sitting down and my rising up; You discern my thought from afar.

segments.text: You know my sitting down and my rising up; You discern my thought from afar.

verses.text: You have fanned My wandering and my lying down, and You are aware of all my ways.

segments.text: You have fanned My wandering and my lying down, and You are aware of all my ways.

verses.text: For [there is] not a word on my tongue—behold, O YHWH, You have known it all.

segments.text: For [there is] not a word on my tongue—behold, O YHWH, You have known it all.

verses.text: Behind and before, You hem me in, and You have laid Your hand upon me.

segments.text: Behind and before, You hem me in, and You have laid Your hand upon me.

verses.text: [Such] knowledge [is] wonderful for me; it is high, I am not able to attain it.

segments.text: [Such] knowledge [is] wonderful for me; it is high, I am not able to attain it.

verses.text: Where can I go from Your Spirit? Or where can I flee from Your face?

segments.text: Where can I go from Your Spirit? Or where can I flee from Your face?

verses.text: If I ascend [to] the heavens, there You [are]; and if I make my bed [in] Sheol, behold, You!

segments.text: If I ascend [to] the heavens, there You [are]; and if I make my bed [in] Sheol, behold, You!

verses.text: [If] I lift up the wings of the morning, if I settle in the furthest part of the sea,

segments.text: [If] I lift up the wings of the morning, if I settle in the furthest part of the sea,

verses.text: even there Your hand will guide me, and Your right hand will hold me fast.

segments.text: even there Your hand will guide me, and Your right hand will hold me fast.

verses.text: And I said, “Surely the darkness will cover me, and the light [become] night around me”—

segments.text: And I said, “Surely the darkness will cover me, and the light [become] night around me”—

verses.text: even the darkness is not dark to You, and the night shines like the day—as the darkness, so [is] the light.

segments.text: even the darkness is not dark to You, and the night shines like the day—as the darkness, so [is] the light.

verses.text: For You have possessed my kidneys; You covered me in the womb of my mother.

segments.text: For You have possessed my kidneys; You covered me in the womb of my mother.

verses.text: I give You praise upon that fearfully I have been distinguished; wonderful [are] Your works, and my soul knows [it] very well.

segments.text: I give You praise upon that fearfully I have been distinguished; wonderful [are] Your works, and my soul knows [it] very well.

verses.text: My bone was not hidden from You when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of earth.

segments.text: My bone was not hidden from You when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of earth.

verses.text: Your eyes saw my unformed body, and in Your book all of them were written—the days fashioned for me, and not one [was] yet among them!

segments.text: Your eyes saw my unformed body, and in Your book all of them were written—the days fashioned for me, and not one [was] yet among them!

verses.text: And how precious are Your thoughts to me, O God! How vast is their sum!

segments.text: And how precious are Your thoughts to me, O God! How vast is their sum!

verses.text: [If] I could count them, they would number more than the sand! I awaken, and I am still with You.

segments.text: [If] I could count them, they would number more than the sand! I awaken, and I am still with You.

verses.text: If only You would slay, O God, the wicked; and the men of blood, may they turn aside from me—

segments.text: If only You would slay, O God, the wicked; and the men of blood, may they turn aside from me—

verses.text: who speak against You for wickedness; Your enemies [are] lifted up to vanity.

segments.text: who speak against You for wickedness; Your enemies [are] lifted up to vanity.

verses.text: Do I not hate those hating you, O YHWH, and I loathe those standing against You?

segments.text: Do I not hate those hating you, O YHWH, and I loathe those standing against You?

verses.text: I have hated them with perfect hatred; they have become as enemies to me!

segments.text: I have hated them with perfect hatred; they have become as enemies to me!

verses.text: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me, and know my thoughts.

segments.text: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me, and know my thoughts.

verses.text: And see if a way of wickedness [is] in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
